title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Elena Cruz
description: Implements a unified autorollback workflow for rollouts (canary, A/B, and shadow traffic) that centralizes policy evaluation, probing, quarantine handling, and observability hooks. Motivation: customers running progressive model rollouts need automated, consistent safeguards across hosted/dedicated/private deployments to reduce incident blast radius and MTTR. This change introduces: 1) an Autorollback engine (policy evaluator + state machine) that consumes rollout configs and streaming telemetry to decide continue/step/fail/rollback; 2) Probing and shadow traffic probes that run in parallel to canary/A-B traffic and feed composite metrics for decisioning; 3) Quarantine stage that halts promotion but keeps probes running for manual inspection; 4) Metric matching and composite thresholds (latency, 5xx rate, hallucination proxy score) with configurable quorum; 5) Observability additions: per-rollout traces, aggregated rollback reasons, and new Prometheus metrics and dashboards; 6) E2E and integration tests that simulate degraded model behavior and validate safe rollback. Checklist: ensure Linear tickets ENG-1823/ENG-1824 are satisfied; add migration for existing rollout CRDs; update console rollout UI docs and templates; manual staged rollout for initial customer cohorts. This description summarizes design, implementation notes, and rollout plan in one place for reviewers.
